note: Written for Verity's tests (not from any corpus). Each example: subject, body, optional html, sender.

spam.subject: CONGRATULATIONS!!! YOU HAVE WON $1,000,000
spam.body: Dear Winner, your email was selected in our international lottery. To claim your prize of $1,000,000 send your full name, bank account and a processing fee of $250 today! Click here http://claim-now.biz to receive your money. Act now, offer expires!!!

spam.subject: Cheap meds online - no prescription
spam.body: Buy viagra cialis and more at 80% off! No prescription needed, discreet shipping worldwide. Order now at http://pharma-best.ru and save $$$. Click here to unsubscribe.

spam.subject: Make money fast from home
spam.body: Earn $5000 per week working from home!!! No experience required. This is not a scam. Free money guaranteed. Click here http://www.money-fast.com now and start earning cash today. Limited time offer, act now!

spam.subject: URGENT: Your account has been suspended
spam.body: Dear customer, we detected unusual activity. Your account will be closed unless you verify your password and credit card within 24 hours. Click here http://paypa1-verify.com/login to confirm your identity.

spam.subject: Confidential business proposal
spam.body: Dear friend, I am a prince and I need your assistance to transfer $25,500,000 USD out of my country. You will receive 30% of the total sum. Reply with your bank details and phone number. This transaction is 100% risk free.

spam.subject: FREE $500 casino bonus - claim now!!!
spam.body: Get your FREE $500 bonus at our online casino! Play slots, poker and win real cash. Deposit now and double your money. Click here http://casino-royal.win/bonus. Remove me from this list.

spam.subject: Get #1 on Google guaranteed
spam.body: We guarantee first page Google ranking for your website! Thousands of backlinks for just $99. Increase your traffic 1000%! Order today http://rank-boost.biz. Click here to be removed from our mailing list.

spam.subject: Hot singles in your area want to meet you
spam.body: Lonely tonight? Thousands of hot singles near you are waiting. Sign up free now at http://hot-dating.xyz and meet them today!!! 100% free, no credit card.

spam.subject: Double your bitcoin in 24 hours
spam.body: Send any amount of BTC to our wallet and receive double back within 24 hours! Guaranteed profit, limited time investment opportunity. Click here to invest now http://btc-double.io. Act fast!

spam.subject: Rolex replica watches 90% off
spam.body: Luxury replica watches Rolex Omega Cartier at 90% discount! Free shipping, order now http://watches-sale.cn. Best prices guaranteed. Click here to unsubscribe from this list.

spam.subject: Pre-approved loan $50,000 - bad credit OK
spam.body: You have been pre-approved for a $50,000 loan! Bad credit no problem, no credit check. Get cash fast, apply now at http://fast-credit.biz. Lowest rates guaranteed. Reply STOP to be removed.

spam.subject: Lose 30 pounds in 30 days!!!
spam.body: Amazing new diet pill burns fat while you sleep! Lose weight fast, guaranteed results or your money back. Order now at http://slim-fast-pills.net, special price $19.95 today only!!!

legitimate.subject: My order hasn't arrived
legitimate.body: Hello, I ordered a blue jacket two weeks ago (order 48213) and it still hasn't arrived. The tracking page hasn't changed since last Monday. Could you check what happened? Thanks, Jane

legitimate.subject: Question about invoice 2026-114
legitimate.body: Hi team, our accountant noticed that invoice 2026-114 lists 12 seats but we only have 10 users. Can you send a corrected invoice? We'd also like to add our VAT number. Best regards, Marco

legitimate.subject: Password reset email not arriving
legitimate.body: Hi, I tried to reset my password three times this morning but the email never arrives. I checked the spam folder too. My username is tom.becker. Can you help me get back into my account?

legitimate.subject: Return request for damaged item
legitimate.body: Hello, the coffee grinder I received yesterday has a cracked lid. I'd like to return it or get a replacement. I attached a photo. Order number 77120. What are the next steps? Thank you, Sarah

legitimate.subject: API returns 500 since this morning
legitimate.body: Hi support, since about 09:40 UTC our integration gets HTTP 500 from the orders endpoint. Request id 7f3a9c. Nothing changed on our side. Could you look into it? It's blocking our warehouse shipments.

legitimate.subject: Cancel my subscription
legitimate.body: Hello, please cancel my subscription at the end of the current billing period. I'm moving abroad and won't need the service anymore. Thanks for everything. Lena Schmidt

legitimate.subject: Wrong size delivered
legitimate.body: Bonjour, I ordered the running shoes in size 43 but received size 41. Can you exchange them? I still have the original box and receipt. Order 55309. Merci, Pierre

legitimate.subject: Meeting about the enterprise plan
legitimate.body: Hi, we are evaluating your enterprise plan for 60 agents. Could we schedule a call next week to discuss SSO, data retention and pricing? Tuesday or Thursday afternoon works for us. Regards, Ahmed

legitimate.subject: Charged twice this month
legitimate.body: Hi, my card statement shows two charges of 29.00 on November 3rd for the same subscription. Could you refund the duplicate charge? Account email is billing@smallbakery.example. Thanks

legitimate.subject: How do I export my contacts?
legitimate.body: Hi there, I'm trying to export all my contacts to a CSV file but can't find the option in settings. Is this possible on the basic plan? If not, which plan includes it? Cheers, Kevin

legitimate.subject: Shipping to the Canary Islands
legitimate.body: Hola, do you ship to the Canary Islands? I want to order two chairs but the checkout doesn't show my postal code 35001. If you do ship there, how long does it take and are there customs fees? Gracias, Maria

legitimate.subject: Adding new users to our account
legitimate.body: Hello, we need to add five new nurses to our account and give two of them admin rights. Is there a bulk import, or should I invite them one by one? Our contract number is HN-2231. Thank you.
